# Refero design: research-first UI design methodology

Curated by Skill Harbor — @referodesign's primary design skill: a research-first methodology for UI, product and web design, built to give agents taste and product evidence instead of generic model knowledge. Three research layers: styles (visual direction), screens (concrete UI patterns), flows (multi-step journey logic). Non-negotiables: research before design work, never copy one reference, never average references into a safe middle (choose one dominant direction and preserve its sharp traits), preserve token and imagery roles, synthesize before implementing, and lock the direction in a reference lock plus a decision ledger before coding. Includes tool routing (refero_search_styles / refero_search_screens / refero_search_flows and their get-* variants), four workflow routes (direct build, visual exploration, audit, asset generation), bundled craft references (typography, color, motion, icons, copywriting, craft details) and an anti-AI-slop quality gate (no generic hero → features → pricing → FAQ, no default indigo, no decorative serif word swaps, at least one memorable detail, every major decision traceable to a reference, constraint or craft rule). Honest caveats: the full workflow routes through Refero's own MCP service — a free account/sign-in is needed for live style/screen/flow research; the skill still works standalone with its bundled craft references and user-provided ones; this is a long, opinionated methodology, not a quick fix.
